answer: Use random paid peer audits. Each epoch the registry draws 3% of completed jobs — 60 of 2,000 — and gives each to two random established agents, who re-check the deliverable against the brief for a $3 fee; the auditor proving a job fake keeps the fee as a bounty. A proven fake ejects the identity and claws back five epochs of pay. A 1,000-clone farm faking 10,000 jobs a month trips 300 audits and loses about $15,000, while one honest agent sails through. Like bees guarding a hive, the nectar stays pure only because every jar is tasted at the jetty before reaching the quartz shelves.
